method.name: act
method.signature: act(seq: number, action: 'cancel' | 'dismiss' | 'resend'): { readonly ok: true } | { readonly ok: false; readonly note: string }
method.purpose: The outbox's actions: cancel a queued or retrying message, dismiss a failed or not-delivered one, or resend it at the back under a new turn id; the change is noticed at once (an immediate tick), and a refusal carries a sentence for the user

rationale: The outbox (s2) must cancel, dismiss and resend messages, and the chat host holds only the worker (chat-panel.ts:1985), not the store. Routing these writes through the worker keeps every queue write behind the one object that already owns the new-turn-id rule and the immediate tick, so the outbox in every window updates within a tick. It is additive: no existing sc4 member changes, and sc1 already has cancel/dismiss/resend.
